featured.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
featured.summaryEn: Box CEO Aaron Levie posted two long threads. First, on productivity: he is now seeing plenty of cases where output is one to two orders of magnitude above pre-AI levels, given the right harness, deep domain understanding, a relatively new codebase, fluency in running multiple agents at once, and low-friction test and deploy. Counterintuitively, the gap is not closing. People who already had depth and are willing to change how they work get outsized leverage, and that compounds as models take on larger and harder p…
featured.insightZh: Box CEO Aaron Levie 本周发了两条长推。第一条讲生产力：他说现在已经能看到不少比 AI 之前高出一到两个数量级的产出案例。前提是合适的 harness、对业务领域有深刻理解、代码库相对较新、能熟练同时调度多个 agent，再加上低摩擦的测试和部署流程。反直觉的是，这种差距并没有因为 AI 普及而缩小，反而是原本积累越深、又愿意换打法的人杠杆越大，而且随着模型能接更大、更难的任务还在复利放大。眼下软件工程最明显，但他认为科研、AEC（建筑工程）、金融、网络安全这类重度依赖电脑操作的领域也会跟上。第二条讲基础设施：长时运行的 agent 会成为常态，而 agent 推理对用户端延迟不敏感，单次任务价值远高于多等一秒的成本，所以推理不必部署在用户附近。推理本身是临时过程，不需要长期存储敏感数据，AI 工厂可以当作临时系统处理，这会改变一部分数据驻留的逻辑。结论是 AI 数据中心的选址会更灵活：愿意抓住机会的州或国家（甚至太空）会受益，主动放弃的则会吃亏。

featured.title: Thibault Sottiaux · OpenAI Codex & ChatGPT 负责人
featured.summaryEn: OpenAI Codex & ChatGPT lead Thibault Sottiaux cleared up confusion about Pro plans: none of them have 5-hour limits, and usage relative to Plus is 10x for Pro 100, 20x for Pro 200, and 50x for Pro 500, which also includes ultrafast access. He then asked publicly whether a "Pro 50" tier would make sense.
featured.insightZh: OpenAI Codex / ChatGPT 负责人 Thibault Sottiaux 出面澄清了 Pro 套餐的额度：所有 Pro 档位都没有 5 小时用量限制，相对 Plus 的用量倍数分别是 Pro 100 为 10 倍、Pro 200 为 20 倍、Pro 500 为 50 倍，Pro 500 还能用 ultrafast。他随后又公开征求意见，问要不要再出一个「Pro 50」档位。对正在给团队采购 Codex / ChatGPT 席位的企业来说，这套分档值得留意。

featured.title: Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev 谈 Tokenization、Agentic Trading 与 Harmonic
featured.summaryEn: Vlad Tenev frames Robinhood as "the ownership company," using tokenization, agentic trading and retail-accessible private funds to put institutional-grade tools and AI-era wealth creation in ordinary people's hands. In math, he argues against AI labs centralizing discovery. Robinhood co-founder and CEO Vlad Tenev says the company now operates in some form in 120+ countries, and everything ties back to ownership: a society without broad ownership is fragile, especially amid AI disruption. Tokenization is "ownership gone global." Like a stablecoin, real-world assets such as US stocks or private-company SPVs go into a box, tokens are minted and burned against it, and those tokens then trade fractionally on-chain and compose with DeFi. This year Robinhood relaunched fully DeFi-enabled stock tokens on Robinhood Chain, which he calls the number one chain for developer activity. To the "corpo…

items.title: Andrej Karpathy · 前 OpenAI 创始成员、前 Tesla AI 负责人
items.summaryEn: After Tristan published his list of top YouTube channels, Andrej Karpathy turned it into "TristanTube": 47K super nerdy videos plus a TV mode for laid-back watching. He says he one-shotted it with Claude Code in three minutes.
items.insightZh: Andrej Karpathy 看到 Tristan 公布的优质 YouTube 频道清单后，顺手做了个「TristanTube」：收录 4.7 万个硬核技术视频，还带一个适合放松观看的 TV 模式。他说这是用 Claude Code 3 分钟一次性做出来的。又一个「想法到可用产品只隔几分钟」的例子。

items.title: Aditya Agarwal · South Park Commons 普通合伙人、前 Dropbox CTO
items.summaryEn: SPC General Partner and former Dropbox CTO Aditya Agarwal argues that if building datacenters gets harder, you should be very long anyone with existing capacity, i.e. the hyperscalers. Demand for "the spice" keeps rising, so the spice holders win big. What suffers is the pace of new model training: "I guess we will pace the frontier after all. The body politic speaketh."
items.insightZh: South Park Commons 普通合伙人、前 Dropbox CTO Aditya Agarwal 的判断是：如果新建数据中心越来越难，那就应该重仓已经握有算力的人，也就是超大规模云厂商。算力需求只会继续上涨，「香料持有者」会大赚；真正受伤的是新模型的训练速度。他调侃说，看来前沿进展终究会被「放慢」，这是民意的结果。

items.title: Garry Tan · Y Combinator 总裁兼 CEO
items.summaryEn: YC President and CEO Garry Tan says the defining political issue of the next decade is whether we can have human progress in science, medicine and engineering through superintelligence, or "choose the darkness." He also shared an essay with the quip "don't show this essay to the NIMBYs."
items.insightZh: YC 总裁兼 CEO Garry Tan 认为，未来十年最核心的政治议题是：我们能否借助超级智能，在科学、医学和工程上实现人类进步与富足，还是「选择黑暗」。他还推荐了一篇文章，并调侃说「别给 NIMBY（邻避主义者）看」。

items.title: Nikunj Kothari · FPV Ventures 合伙人
items.summaryEn: FPV Ventures partner Nikunj Kothari posted a satirical playbook for getting seven Series A term sheets: vague-post revenue charts with no y-axis, ship multiple launch videos, get trendsetter customers and the labs to mention you, buy "articles" in "premier" publications, chant "long horizon agent swarms, world models, physical AI," and insist you have no deck because you are not raising. In his words, the whole thing is satire, but each line on its own is true. He also announced his next IRL off-the-record session…
items.insightZh: FPV Ventures 合伙人 Nikunj Kothari 写了一篇讽刺「如何让投资人 FOMO、拿到七份 A 轮 term sheet」的帖子：营收图不标 Y 轴，连发功能发布视频，找标杆客户和大模型实验室帮背书，花钱买「顶级媒体」软文，然后堆砌「long horizon agent swarms / world models / physical AI」这类关键词，最后再说「我们没在融资，所以没有 deck，也没有 data room」。他强调整篇是讽刺，但每一条单独看都是真的。另外他宣布下一期线下闭门对谈（11 月 11 日，旧金山）请到 Arcanum Labs 联合创始人 Daniel Rupawalla，聊 AI 训练数据市场：实验室在买什么、谁在卖、这个市场能不能持续。

items.title: Zara Zhang · Builder
items.summaryEn: Builder Zara Zhang pushes back on the idea that startup fates are predestined ("X will never work," "Y is too niche"). Fates are made: one idea can be executed a thousand ways, and brilliant people with brilliant execution often create something from nothing, or make the impossible look obvious in hindsight.
items.insightZh: Builder Zara Zhang 反驳了「创业命运早已注定」的说法，比如「X 点子肯定不行」「Y 市场太小众」。她认为创业的命运是做出来的：同一个点子有一千种执行方式，一百个人会有一百种打法；优秀的人加上出色的执行，常常能无中生有，事后再看会觉得理所当然。

items.title: Peter Steinberger · OpenClaw 作者、OpenAI
items.summaryEn: OpenClaw creator Peter Steinberger (now at OpenAI) criticized the Asahi project: it was all about opening up something closed and restricted, so adding new restrictions that make it harder for others to build on it is the wrong direction, and "that AI rejection is just silly."
items.insightZh: OpenClaw 作者 Peter Steinberger（现任职 OpenAI）批评了 Asahi Linux 项目的新做法。他说 Asahi 的初衷是把封闭受限的东西开放出来，现在却加新限制、让其他项目更难在它之上构建，这个方向不对，而拒绝 AI 贡献的规定「很蠢」。

items.title: Amjad Masad · Replit CEO
items.summaryEn: Replit CEO Amjad Masad said he really enjoyed Kazakhstan, calling it a "super AI pilled government" and a great place for the Network School. He also shared a piece titled "The Better Lesson."
items.insightZh: Replit CEO Amjad Masad 分享了哈萨克斯坦之行的感受：当地政府「非常 AI-pilled」，对 AI 很积极，他认为那里也很适合办 Network School。他另外转发了一篇题为《The Better Lesson》的文章。
